title: corrupted DB doctor bundle v2
description: Issue #671: doctor --bundle must create a privacy-preserving bundle even when the graph database is malformed and cannot be opened.

decisions.answer: 以 issue #671 的 corrupted DB doctor bundle v2 作为本轮 P0。
decisions.note: 先补齐 status 能判 corrupted 之后 doctor 仍能打包的闭环，再考虑 degraded summary 持久化。

1-1.label: 复现 corrupted DB doctor bundle 失败路径
1-1.notes: Added failing doctor bundle regression: malformed .zcodegraph/zcodegraph.db currently aborts with 'file is not a database' before bundle creation.

1-2.label: 设计不打开 DB 的 corrupted bundle 采集路径

decisions.q: corrupted bundle 的触发边界是什么？
decisions.answer: doctor bundle 不应为了补齐 graph stats 而打开当前 DB；如果 DB malformed，应写入 DB 元数据和 sanitized open error。
decisions.note: 即使 last-run 记录缺少 statusSummary，也不能在 bundle 阶段调用 CodeGraph.open。

1-2.notes: Design decision recorded: bundle fallback status must classify DB corruption from filesystem metadata and sanitized open errors instead of requiring CodeGraph.open during bundle creation.

1-3.label: 实现 corrupted DB 隐私安全诊断 bundle
1-3.notes: Implemented corrupted status fallback inside diagnostics: bundle creation now records DB file metadata, sanitized open error, graph health, diagnostic record availability, and graph-stats unavailableReason=corrupted without throwing.

1-4.label: 验证 status 非破坏性与 doctor bundle 门禁
1-4.notes: Verification passed: npx vitest run __tests__/status-json.test.ts __tests__/rust-hybrid-doctor.test.ts; npm run build; git diff --check.

1-5.label: 收尾 issue 关联 changelog 与 PR 准备
1-5.notes: Changelog entry added for #671. Branch is ready for review/PR after local verification; no release or publish action taken.
